title: 第13章：卖菜
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
出门没多久，马超就找了个无人的地方进入时空屋，隔着屏幕观察外面的情况。

    幸亏上一次，马超将时空锚点定在附近的公共厕所，终于瞅准四周无人进出的空隙，一步踏出。

    落地瞬间，马超紧了紧背篓，然后快速出去。

    外面天色已经大亮，早市正是热闹的时候。沿街的早餐摊冒着滚滚热气，油条、豆浆、豆腐脑、鲜肉包子、馄饨、香酥牛肉饼的味道交织在一起，勾得人胃里直发空。

    马超肚子咕咕叫了一声。

    他心里苦笑一声。昨天手里攒的钱，全部拿去买了猪板油和五花肉，一分不剩。眼下满街美食，他却半点都买不起。

    当务之急，是赶紧把野菜卖掉换钱。

    他压下饥饿，背着竹筐快步走向熟悉的摆摊区。

    远远的，他就看见了已经出摊的摊贩们。

    “小超！这边！”

    王大爷眼尖，立马朝他招手。
content_en:
Not long after leaving the house, Ma Chao found a deserted place and entered the space-time room, observing the situation outside through the screen.

    Fortunately, last time, Ma Chao set the anchor point of time and space at a nearby public toilet, finally looked at the gap where no one was entering or leaving, and stepped out.

    The moment he landed, Ma Chao tightened his backpack and went out quickly.

    It's getting dark outside, and the morning market is bustling. The breakfast stalls along the street are steaming with steam, and the smells of fried dough sticks, soy milk, tofu curd, fresh meat buns, wontons, and crispy beef patties are intertwined, making people feel empty in their stomachs.

    Ma Chao's stomach growled.

    He smiled bitterly inwardly. All the money I saved yesterday was used to buy pork suet and pork belly, and not a penny was left. Nowadays, the streets are full of delicacies, but he can't afford any of them.

    The top priority is to quickly sell the wild vegetables for money.

    He suppressed his hunger and walked quickly towards the familiar stall area with a bamboo basket on his back.

    From a distance, he saw the vendors who had already set out their stalls.

    "Superboy! This way!"

    Uncle Wang had sharp eyes and immediately waved to him.
